mentions.name: cloud-doctor
mentions.description: A react-doctor style CLI that deterministically scans projects for misconfigurations, missing observability, and security posture. It is being extended so vibe-coders can secure their apps too, and it is free and open source.
mentions.problem: Cloud apps can ship with misconfigurations, missing observability, and a weak security posture that developers need to detect and fix.
mentions.audience: Cloud app developers, including AI-assisted ("vibe") coders who want to secure their apps
mentions.source_excerpt:
Created a react-doctor style cli to deterministically scan for misconfigurations, missing observability, and security posture. 
Now working on extending it so vibe-coders can secure their apps too!

All free and open source: https://github.com/DumbMachine/cloud-doctor
